alerts.title: Annual TDF renal monitoring may be overdue
alerts.message: Guidelines require serum creatinine and eGFR monitoring every 12 months for experienced patients on TDF. The patient has been on TDF since June 2022 and has only one creatinine result on record (76 umol/L, 2025-12-15). No eGFR has been documented. The clinician's plan does not include renal function monitoring.

evidence.recommended_action: Obtain serum creatinine and calculate eGFR to fulfill annual TDF renal monitoring requirements. Consider scheduling renal function tests if not recently completed.

alerts.title: Next viral load due in ~8 months
alerts.message: Guidelines specify routine viral load monitoring every 12 months for suppressed adults on ART. The patient's latest viral load (20 copies/mL) was done 129 days before this visit and was suppressed. The next annual viral load is due around September 2026. The clinician's plan does not mention scheduling the next viral load test.

evidence.recommended_action: Confirm next annual viral load is scheduled around September 2026 to maintain guideline-concordant monitoring for this suppressed adult.
